courses.subject: MUIR
courses.title: Muir Special Project
courses.description: A course of independent work on a research or creative project to satisfy a Muir graduation requirement. (Only Muir students who have had Muir Special Project proposals approved may enroll in this course.) Students wishing to enroll must submit a written request with a description of the project. (Muir students must submit the Muir Special Project 199 form to the major advisor and to the Office of the Provost by the seventh week of the quarter prior to the quarter in which the 199 is to be undertaken. For information on other requirements, consult the provost’s office.)
courses.prereqText: upper-division status, approval by project advisor and by provost. (Letter grades only.)

courses.subject: MCWP
courses.title: Critical Writing
courses.description: First course of sequence in university reading and writing which satisfies the Muir College graduation requirement in writing. Required of all Muir College first-year students and of transfer students who have not completed a comparable course elsewhere. MCWP 40 introduces students to the basic elements of argument and analysis. Students engage in close reading of texts, weekly writing and revision, and individual conferences. Grades of C or higher are required for prerequisites. Students must take MCWP 40 for a letter grade to count toward the Muir College writing requirement. Students may receive credit for one of the following: MCWP 40, MCWP 40R, MCWP 40C, or MCWP 40CR.
courses.prereqText: satisfaction of Entry Level Writing Requirement.

courses.subject: MCWP
courses.title: CritWrit: Climate Change
courses.description: First course of sequence which satisfies the Muir College graduation requirement in writing. Required of all Muir College first-year students and of transfer students who have not completed a comparable course elsewhere. MCWP 40C introduces students to the basic elements of argument and analysis with a focus on climate change. Students engage in close reading of texts, weekly writing and revision, and individual conferences. Satisfies the Jane Teranes Climate Change Education Requirement. Grades of C or higher are required for prerequisites. Students must take MCWP 40C for a letter grade to count toward the Muir College writing requirement. Students may receive credit for one of the following: MCWP 40, MCWP 40R, MCWP 40C, or MCWP 40CR.
